name: Morse.IsCriticalPoint
hypotheses: f differentiable at p (in particular f smooth, as in the textbook); exactly: P ↔ T iff (T → DifferentiableAt ℝ f p)
difference: Junk values: the project requires HasFDerivAt f 0 p, the blind definition only fderiv ℝ f p = 0, which also holds (as Mathlib's junk) at points where f is not differentiable. P ⇒ T always; |x| at 0 satisfies T but not P.
why: Proved P → T, agreement under DifferentiableAt (project lemma isCriticalPoint_iff), the exact characterisation of agreement, and the counterexample |x| at 0. The difference lies only outside the textbook's smoothness hypothesis. Note the project is itself inconsistent here: its manifold version IsCriticalPointM uses the junk-tolerant mfderiv = 0.
